claude.performance_metric: Deal terminated (not consummated); $103M termination fee received; Avista remained independent NYSE-listed with FY2020 net income $129.5M
claude.rationale: The proposed Hydro One acquisition of Avista was never consummated — it was blocked by WUTC regulatory denial and terminated by mutual agreement in January 2019, with Avista continuing as an independent NYSE-listed registrant through the outcome window. Because no combined entity ever came into being, there could be no realized post-deal disruption at the product/process interface (p4=0) or the process/organization interface (p5=0); no integration occurred over time to fracture. Likewise there is no documented archetype incoherence (t1) or business-model incompatibility (t2) playing out post-close, since integration never took place.

grok.performance_metric: deal not consummated; $103M termination fee; remained independent

Because no combined entity or integration occurred, there is no documented product/process interface disruption (p4) or process/organization fracture (p5).
